what: The title is split into word chunks. Once even 1px of the element enters the screen, each word comes into focus from 10px blur and transparent over 1.3s (.1s stagger, default curve power1.out, once). Lowering the end opacity (opacity: .5) reuses the same feel for blurred subtitles and numbers. With on: load it runs right on attach after the delay, as in the Hero title

options.opacity: End opacity, default 1 — faint subtitle is .5, large gray title is .2
options.ease: Curve, default power1.out — GSAP name or ”0.16,1,0.3,1”
options.on: If 「load」, it starts right away without waiting to be visible
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom (1px entering)
options.rise: How many % of its own height a word rises from below, default 0 (in place) — interfere hero title 20
options.split: If ”none”, it settles per element instead of splitting into words — text paragraphs and photo cells (text optional)
options.scale: Grows from this multiple up to 1 and settles, default 1 — photo frame .95 (together with blur 0)

use:
Your title here

· Hero: data-fx-blur-word-reveal="on: load; delay: .4" · Blurred number: data-fx-blur-word-reveal="opacity: .5" · per paragraph: data-fx-blur-word-reveal="split: none; dur: 1; ease: power2.out" · Photo cell: data-fx-blur-word-reveal="split: none; blur: 0; scale: .95; dur: 1.2; ease: power2.out"

from.where: index.html .hero__title — original code is hero-transition (.8s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1), staggered .04s from .4s, 10px blur · 20% below), but on the real screen 97% finishes within 1s from the first frame, so the copy follows the measurement with data-fx-blur-word-reveal="on: load; delay: .24; stagger: .025; dur: .5; rise: 20; ease: 0.25,0.1,0.25,1"

index.html all text paragraphs and headings (original .text-animation — whole element blur 10px and transparent to clear in 1s power2.out, .6s on phone, once when its top edge touches the bottom of the screen) and photo slots (.image-animation — .95 scale and transparent, 1.2s power2.out) → split: none option
